findings.detail: Description of "analyze_activity_file" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: analyze_activity_file, create_upload_link, get_track_replay_3d, get_track_stats, search_athletes, search_tracks · Private data: analyze_activity_file, create_ephemeral_replay, create_upload_link, get_track_replay_3d, get_track_stats, import_activity · Public sink: analyze_activity_file, create_ephemeral_replay, create_upload_link, get_track_replay_3d, import_activity · Destructive: analyze_activity_file, create_ephemeral_replay, create_upload_link, import_activity.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: analyze_activity_file, create_upload_link, get_track_replay_3d, get_track_stats, search_athletes, search_tracks · Private data: analyze_activity_file, create_ephemeral_replay, create_upload_link, get_track_replay_3d, get_track_stats, import_activity · Public sink: analyze_activity_file, create_ephemeral_replay, create_upload_link, get_track_replay_3d, import_activity · Destructive: analyze_activity_file, create_ephemeral_replay, create_upload_link, import_activity

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
